input: Find a local astronomy club for monthly star parties

gold.taskTitle: Find a Local Astronomy Club for Star Parties
gold.taskDescription: Research and connect with a nearby astronomy club that hosts monthly star party events.

questions.title: What city or region are you searching in?
questions.description: Knowing the user's location narrows the search to relevant local clubs.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to attend?
questions.description: Understanding the maximum travel distance helps filter clubs by proximity.

questions.title: Are you a complete beginner or an experienced observer?
questions.description: Experience level helps identify clubs that match the user's knowledge and expectations.

questions.title: Do you own a telescope or other equipment already?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user has gear helps identify clubs that lend equipment or expect members to bring their own.

questions.title: Is joining as a paid member something you are open to?
questions.description: Some clubs require membership fees; knowing the user's preference filters options accordingly.

questions.title: Do you prefer a large club or a small tight-knit group?
questions.description: Club size affects the social dynamic and depth of mentorship available to the user.

questions.title: Are there specific topics you most want to focus on?
questions.description: Interests such as astrophotography, deep-sky observing, or planetary viewing help match the user to a club with aligned activities.
